title: IllusionCircle
description: A Casual games. twelve brilliant circles are generated in each screen of the game. When you start to observe the twelve circles in the game screen, you will feel that each circle is rotating. In fact, there are only A circle is actually rotating.You can get score by click this circle
description_short: IllusionCircle is a unique and very interesting game, and you will be deeply shocked by it.Make you believe that the world is not real. You will find it very difficult to get a higher score. You need to challenge your limits.It's a good choice to give it as a gift to your friends this Christmas.
